render_rst_to_html: render a reStructuredText string to HTML body content using the SaneHtmlWriter and docutils Publisher
hyphenate_text: hyphenate a text string with soft hyphen characters using pyphen for a given language
dehyphenate_text: dehyphenate a text string by removing soft hyphen entities from previously hyphenated content
register_mcss_filters: register Jinja2 filters including render_rst, hyphenate, dehyphenate, and rtrim on a Jinja environment
register_pelican_plugin: register the htmlsanity Pelican plugin to connect signals and add the custom RST reader
